steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each permit is placed by whether it overlaps another in its area or is past its expiry.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 permits conflict or are out of date

findings.title: Two active permits for overlapping work in one area
findings.fix: Suspend one permit until the work is separated

findings.title: Permit past its expiry still marked active
findings.fix: Close the permit and record it

outcome.notChecked: Whether the work is carried out as the permit states; the physical isolation.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks two active permits for overlapping work in one area, a permit past its expiry still marked active, a permit with no isolation reference where the work type needs one, and a suspended permit with no re.
cons: Not checked: Whether the work is carried out as the permit states; the physical isolation.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-permit-to-work skill on the records for this review.
